toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, relative to path, e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'. A pattern without '/' matches file names at any depth

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

package config

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type ValueType string

const (
	TypeString      ValueType = "string"
	TypeInteger     ValueType = "integer"
	TypeBoolean     ValueType = "boolean"
	TypeDuration    ValueType = "duration"
	TypeStringArray ValueType = "array of strings"
	TypeTableArray  ValueType = "array of tables"
)

type KeySpec struct {
	Key      string
	Type     ValueType
	Allowed  []string
	Default  any
	Meaning  string
	UserOnly bool
}

var keySpecs = []KeySpec{
	{Key: "review_parallel", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"greenhouse"}, Meaning: "Record Greenhouse Verdicts in parallel with the built-in review loop; unset disables parallel requests.", UserOnly: true},
	{Key: "budget.daily_tokens", Type: TypeInteger, Default: int64(0), Meaning: "Per-Project token limit for the host-local calendar day; 0 disables it."},
	{Key: "budget.task_tokens", Type: TypeInteger, Default: int64(0), Meaning: "Default total-token limit per Task; a Brief budget_tokens value overrides it. 0 disables it."},
	{Key: "identity.lead.name", Type: TypeString, Default: "Lead", Meaning: "Display name and Lead voice toward the User."},
	{Key: "identity.lead.persona", Type: TypeString, Default: "", Meaning: "Lead persona used only when speaking to the User."},
	{Key: "identity.lead.language", Type: TypeString, Default: "en", Meaning: "Language for Lead messages to the User. Briefs, send instructions, reviews, Reports, commit messages and other artifacts stay in English."},
	{Key: "identity.lead.address_user", Type: TypeString, Default: "", Meaning: "How the Lead addresses the User."},
	{Key: "identity.worker.display_prefix", Type: TypeString, Default: "worker", Meaning: "Deprecated; retained for compatibility and has no effect on Herdr labels or Task names."},
	{Key: "lead.kind", Type: TypeString, Default: "", Meaning: "Default agent kind used by posse up."},
	{Key: "lowkey.lead", Type: TypeBoolean, Default: false, Meaning: "Lowkey mode for the Lead: only report decisions and outcomes to the User. A display preference, not an autonomy grant."},
	{Key: "notify.command", Type: TypeString, Default: "", Meaning: "Command that receives JSON User-actionable Notices on stdin; command failures and timeouts are logged without delaying Notice delivery.", UserOnly: true},
	{Key: "knowledge.enabled", Type: TypeBoolean, Default: false, Meaning: "Load curated User and Project knowledge into Lead instructions and new Worker launches, and allow knowledge writes. Knowledge is reference context, not authority (ADR 0032).", UserOnly: true},
	{Key: "knowledge.budget_bytes", Type: TypeInteger, Default: 8192, Meaning: "Startup budget for always-loaded knowledge plus the same role's preferences; a knowledge write that grows an over-budget total is refused until entries are curated."},
	{Key: "skills.lead", Type: TypeStringArray, Default: []string{}, Meaning: "Workflow skills the Lead loads on top of the platform skills: bundled skill names or absolute or ~/ paths to directories holding SKILL.md. A Project list replaces the User list."},
	{Key: "skills.change", Type: TypeStringArray, Default: []string{}, Meaning: "Workflow skills Change Task Workers load on top of the platform skills, frozen at admission; entries as in skills.lead."},
	{Key: "skills.review", Type: TypeStringArray, Default: []string{}, Meaning: "Workflow skills Review Round Workers load on top of the platform skills, frozen at admission; entries as in skills.lead."},
	{Key: "skills.research", Type: TypeStringArray, Default: []string{}, Meaning: "Workflow skills Research Workers load on top of the platform skills, frozen at admission; entries as in skills.lead."},
	{Key: "lead.profiles.<kind>", Type: TypeString, Meaning: "Profile used by the Lead for this agent kind."},
	{Key: "defaults.max_workers", Type: TypeInteger, Default: 4, Meaning: "Maximum concurrent Workers for a Project."},
	{Key: "defaults.dispatch_inheritance", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"kind", "lead_profile"}, Default: "kind", Meaning: "Profile inherited when no Dispatch Rule matches: the Lead's agent kind only, or its resolved Profile."},
	{Key: "defaults.stall_after", Type: TypeDuration, Default: "20m", Meaning: "Time without output or worktree progress before a Worker is stalled."},
	{Key: "defaults.idle_after", Type: TypeDuration, Default: "3m", Meaning: "Time a Worker may be idle without a Signal before a Notice is created."},
	{Key: "defaults.auto_teardown", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"finished", "merged", "never"}, Default: "finished", Meaning: "Whether completed Tasks are automatically Teardown after merging or Notice acknowledgement."},
	{Key: "defaults.recovery_attempts", Type: TypeInteger, Default: 3, Meaning: "Maximum relaunch attempts per Worker during one `posse up --all` restore episode; exhaustion requires explicit relaunch."},
	{Key: "defaults.recovery_backoff", Type: TypeDuration, Default: "5s", Meaning: "Initial delay between failed Worker relaunches during a restore; doubles up to one minute."},
	{Key: "defaults.merge_mode", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"local", "pr"}, Default: "pr", Meaning: "How Change Task changes are Merged."},
	{Key: "defaults.target_branch", Type: TypeString, Default: "", Meaning: "Default PR/MR target branch for Change Tasks; empty uses each repository's default branch."},
	{Key: "defaults.forge", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"auto", "github", "gitlab"}, Default: "auto", Meaning: "Forge for this Project; auto detects from each repository remote."},
	{Key: "repositories.<repository>.forge", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"auto", "github", "gitlab"}, Default: "auto", Meaning: "Override the forge for a member repository."},
	{Key: "defaults.merge_method", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"squash", "merge", "rebase"}, Default: "squash", Meaning: "Merge method used for pull requests."},
	{Key: "defaults.require_current_target", Type: TypeBoolean, Default: false, Meaning: "Require a PR/MR head to contain the current target tip before final CI evidence and Merge, asking behind Workers to merge the target through a per-target merge queue (ADR 0019, ADR 0031); when false, a green, mergeable PR merges while behind and only conflicts ask the Worker to merge the target.", UserOnly: true},
	{Key: "defaults.pr_poll", Type: TypeDuration, Default: "2m", Meaning: "Minimum interval between pull request and Project checkout polls."},
	{Key: "defaults.review", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"none", "quick", "full-pipeline"}, Default: "none", Meaning: "Review evidence required to Merge a Change Task. full-pipeline validates a private candidate through review, test, docs and lint before every publication.", UserOnly: true},
	{Key: "repositories.<member>.review", Type: TypeString, Allowed: []string{"none", "quick", "full-pipeline"}, Meaning: "Override defaults.review for this workspace Member.", UserOnly: true},
